summary: Reviewed the complete terminal proposal and its implemented personal-operator foundation boundary: in-process host handles, immutable Project/binding identity, cwd confinement, conservative replay filtering, sequence journal bounds, receipt-bound legacy import and durable ended-session recovery. Remaining transport, grants, SDK, Ghostty and supervisor work is explicitly proposed.
limits: Focused real-PTY and journal tests establish only their executed seams. The legacy socket retains its old authority. Windows/ConPTY is exercised by the session, socket, retention and supervisor suites and one live Windows browser journey, with cmd.exe only; native clients, remote/relay/hosted admission, supervisor survival, power-loss durability, retention Settings, aggregate/age retention, purge and manual ownership recovery remain unqualified or unimplemented. A source-reviewed proposal is not SDK-5 delivery.
checks: EXECUTED: focused terminal and bootstrap suites, including real node-pty sessions, history migration, scoped refusals, replay control filtering, and journal bounds.
REASONED: current personal-host/operator composition and the preserved legacy socket boundary; independent security review and fault receipts are recorded separately.
EXECUTED: on Windows 11 with cmd.exe on ConPTY, the seven terminal process suites, six fault injections and tests/live/terminal-restart-journey.mjs (reload, station restart, stop and start).
NOT_VERIFIED: the Desktop app, native clients, other Windows shells, remote/relay/hosted admission, and power-loss durability.
